lines.t: I saw a star fall from heaven, while the sons of men laughed, for they have no vision.
Neither are they able to see beyond that which is in front of them.
And even this they deny, for they love deception, and the truth is not at all convenient.
Yet the sons of God hold their tongues
As tears run down their faces
They look upon creation with new eyes
Embracing the promise of abiding in the hope of salvation
